primitives.name: Snapshot-Only File Classifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: Produce two lists: a) SNAPSHOT-ONLY: source files present in the zip but ABSENT from the live worktree — with a one-line read of what each does (read the file; do not guess from the name).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{\\text{snap}}': 'set of source files in snapshot', 'F_{\\text{live}}': 'set of source files in live worktree', 'F_{\\text{diff}}': 'set of files in F_{\\text{snap}} \\setminus F_{\\text{live}}'}
primitives.assumptions: Files are uniquely identified by path; material difference implies non-trivial content change.

layer2.mapping: Maps file existence differences to mechanism readiness states in GSE's live branch.
layer2.telemetry: File count in F_{\text{diff}}, classification verdicts (WIRE-CANDIDATE, STALE, JUNK)

primitives.name: Diverged File Analyzer
primitives.verbatim_quote: b) DIVERGED: files present in both but materially different (not whitespace) — with the one-line substance of the difference.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{\\text{both}}': 'set of files in both snapshot and live', 'D_{\\text{diff}}': 'set of files in F_{\\text{both}} with material content difference'}
primitives.assumptions: Material difference is defined as non-whitespace content variance.

layer2.mapping: Derives semantic drift in mechanisms through content comparison.
layer2.telemetry: Number of diverged files, per-file difference summary

primitives.name: Wire-Candidate Verdict Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: Mark each SNAPSHOT-ONLY file: WIRE-CANDIDATE (would add a real mechanism to the live branch), STALE (superseded — name the live replacement), or JUNK (fixtures/one-off scripts).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V_{\\text{verdict}}': 'classification verdict set {WIRE-CANDIDATE, STALE, JUNK}', 'F_{\\text{snap-only}}': 'set of snapshot-only files'}
primitives.assumptions: Verdicts are derived from file content and known mechanism mappings.
primitives.breakdown_regime: For all F \in F_{\text{snap-only}}, apply classification logic.

layer2.mapping: Maps snapshot-only files to GSE mechanism insertion points or obsolescence.
layer2.telemetry: Verdict distribution across F_{\text{snap-only}}, replacement mechanism names

The set difference F_{\text{diff}} = F_{\text{snap}} \setminus F_{\text{live}} defines snapshot-only files. Material divergence D_{\text{diff}} ⊆ F_{\text{both}} is determined by content comparison. Classification V_{\text{verdict}} maps these into actionable categories. This forms a dual kernel of file-state and mechanism-state tracking. Failure modes include misclassification due to incomplete file reading or incorrect assumption of mechanism identity. The system must maintain consistency between snapshot and live paths to avoid false positives.
